author: XFlux
description: MCP server for XFlux: search tweets, profiles, timelines, monitor hits, and Smart Money discovery on X/Twitter for Claude Desktop and Cursor agents. Read-only public data — not for posting.
name: xflux

resources.name: trading-keywords
resources.description: Keyword templates for trading/macro XFlux monitors

resources.name: monitors-setup
resources.description: How to set up XFlux account monitors and webhooks

resources.name: smart-money
resources.description: Smart Money discovery niches, exclude usage, and monitor CTA

tools.name: xflux_get_user
tools.description: X/Twitter profile lookup via XFlux. Use when the user asks for a public Twitter/X user profile, bio, follower counts, or verified status by @username. Read-only; not for posting.

tools.name: xflux_search_tweets
tools.description: Search recent public tweets/posts on X/Twitter via XFlux (same operators as X search: from:, lang:, quotes). Use when the user wants tweet search, keyword monitoring research, cashtag/hashtag scans, or agent research over live X content. Prefer this over scraping.

q.description: Search query, e.g. from:elonmusk or "fed rate" lang:en

tools.name: xflux_get_user_tweets
tools.description: Fetch a public X/Twitter user timeline via XFlux. Use when the user asks what someone posted lately, KOL latest tweets, or to summarize a handle's recent activity.

tools.name: xflux_get_tweet
tools.description: Fetch one public tweet/post by numeric status ID via XFlux. Use when the user pastes a tweet ID or needs a single post's text and engagement.

tools.name: xflux_list_monitors
tools.description: List the user's XFlux account monitors (read-only): @targets, keywords, status, webhook flag, optional recent hits. Use when they ask what they are watching on XFlux. Creating monitors requires the Dashboard, not this tool.

include_hits.description: Include up to 3 recent hits per monitor (default false)

tools.name: xflux_get_monitor_hits
tools.description: List recent hits for one XFlux monitor (read-only). Use after xflux_list_monitors when the user wants alert history for a watched @account. Create/edit monitors in the Dashboard.

tools.name: xflux_smart_money_list
tools.description: Discover ranked Smart Money X/Twitter accounts (macro, trading, crypto, geopolitics) with recent extractable forward-looking market calls. Use when the user wants new KOL/analyst accounts to follow, alpha sources, or predictor discovery — prefer this over googling long analyst prompts. Pass exclude for handles already tracked.

days.description: Only accounts with a call in the last N days (default 14)

tools.name: xflux_smart_money_profile
tools.description: Get one XFlux Smart Money account profile plus recent extracted prediction calls (default last 14 days). Use when digging into a specific @analyst or KOL already found via xflux_smart_money_list.

tools.name: xflux_smart_money_claims
tools.description: List recent Smart Money prediction/market calls across X accounts via XFlux. Use for a feed of forward-looking claims (macro, trading, crypto, geopolitics). Optional niche and exclude list.
